objective: Produce a structured technical inquiry into SQLite WAL concurrency boundaries under high-frequency multithreaded readers.

authorized_context.failure_phenomenon: Intermittent SQLITE_BUSY returns during checkpointing while long-running reader holds read transaction open.

forbidden_assumptions: Do not assume WAL mode permits infinite concurrent write transactions (only one writer is allowed).
Do not assume increasing busy_timeout eliminates checkpoint lock starvation indefinitely.
Do not invent synthetic SQL syntax not supported by SQLite.
source_of_truth: SQLite Official Architecture Documentation: File Locking and Concurrency in SQLite Version 3.
